text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Phew...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Whoops, a phone call?

text_block_list.name: Ace's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“――Good morning! Looks like you're out 
running as usual, even at New Year's.”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Mom! What's up? I already gave you my New 
Year's greetings right when the year 
turned, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Ace's Father
text_block_list.text:
—Don't be so distant. Does a parent really 
need a reason to call their daughter?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"What, Dad's here too?! He looks pretty 
relaxed this morning."

text_block_list.name: Ace's Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, gotta let your hair down at the start 
of the year! And since I've got the time, 
thought I'd come cheer on our Ace!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Races are only gonna get tougher from 
here, right? Whenever it gets too hard, 
you're always welcome back home! You 
worked plenty hard last year, after all!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Mom... Dad... Thanks for worrying about 
me!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, I'm totally fine! So just 
you wait. Look forward to how I run in the 
Classic tier...!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll be looking forward to watching in 
front of the TV. Don't catch a cold, and 
do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: —Ah, Ace-chan. Happy New Year...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Happy New Year! That's right, you two 
were getting back from visiting home 
today, weren't you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Es-cchi, could it be... you were doing 
extra morning training again?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I wanted to start the new year fired 
up.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: ......Ace-chan really is incredible.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Far from bouncing back, someone like me 
can't even run properly in practice races 
anymore... Ever since my debut, I've just 
been a total wreck.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
—I ran in a bunch of Junior Class races, 
but I still ended up maiden. My only 
finish on the board was my debut...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
When I went back home, everyone was just 
full of pity for me. ...That honestly 
stung pretty bad.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
...At the end of the year, the two of us 
were talking, saying things like... "Going 
back to the academy feels kind of tough, 
doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —...So, that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—And now, let us hear from Mr. C.B., who 
captured so much attention last year, 
regarding her future plans."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's C.B.-san, huh... Doing interviews 
right at the start of the year—truly the 
representative of our generation. ...She's 
gotten even further away now.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"—What are your upcoming race plans? Will 
you be pursuing the Classic Triple Crown?! 
Is your next start the Kyodo News Hai or 
the Yayoi Sho?!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Umm, I haven't really thought about 
anything yet."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't really decided on any specific 
race. Just gonna run whatever I feel like 
if I'm in good shape."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"However, it is already decided that you 
will walk the Triple Crown route, 
correct...?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, did I say that? I don't really 
remember saying it myself."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Well, the Satsuki Sho is an interesting 
race, but I haven't decided to run it at 
all. ...What matters is whether I want to 
run it or not."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"So when it comes to the Triple Crown or 
whatever— honestly, I'm not that 
interested."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
So that's how CB-san is... —Somehow, that 
makes me feel a bit relieved.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, yeah. If CB-chan shines any 
brighter than this... there really won't 
be any reason for us to run—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Hm? S-cchi, what's up?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, I just remembered I have 
something to do. Catch you another time!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ace-chan—

Katsuragi Ace's Classic Year had begun. To 
organize our plans going forward, I was 
walking through the deserted campus at the 
start of the year when—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Sorry! I wasn't looking ahead――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer...?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —...Just a bit.

After hearing from Katsuragi Ace about her 
recent conversation with her friends and 
what Mr. C.B. had said—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
When CB said she wasn't interested in the 
Triple Crown, and those two heard it and 
said they were "relieved"... to be honest, 
I almost screamed.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Don't say that," "Don't just decide it's 
meaningless," "Don't accept reality before 
you even fight"—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“Still... I couldn't say it. I shouldn't 
say it so lightly...!”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
They are fighting their own battle. It's 
not my place to barge in. ...And above 
all—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'm still not the "ace."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Coming from someone like me who hasn't 
achieved anything, whether I fired them up 
or tried to comfort them, it would all 
feel half-baked... That's what I thought.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks for listening. I feel a little 
better now, thanks to you.

"...Katsuragi Ace is right. The persuasive 
power to overturn a harsh reality can only 
come from someone who has conquered it."

For the sake of Katsuragi Ace and her 
friends, we must demonstrate it through 
our own path.

Even when faced with harsh reality, 
continuing to fight always has meaning. 
And as her Trainer, I――
choice_data_list: I'll fight right alongside you, too...!

Because I'll be fighting alongside you 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
............Heheh. Seriously, thanks. That 
perked me up more than anything today!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to switch gears! First on 
the agenda, CB!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If she's got no interest in the Triple 
Crown route, I'll just have to make her 
interested...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"And on top of that! On the Triple Crown 
route where she is!! I'll fight!!! And 
I'll win!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer! Riding this momentum, let's do 
something to celebrate today!! I wanna 
keep this fire burning even hotter!!”

We certainly want to keep this momentum 
going. What came to mind on my end was—
choice_data_list: Binge eating to recharge my energy
Writing our big goal for the New Year

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Training is definitely the classic 
way to go!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided, let's go, 
Trainer! Let's do this, let's do this--!
choice_data_list:
No need to rush, training isn't going 
anywhere!

No need to panic, training isn't running 
away!

text_block_list.text:
And so, starting the New Year with a 
refreshed mindset, we devoted ourselves to 
training—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Food, huh! Eating to pump ourselves up 
sounds like a great idea! Now that that's 
settled—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—One super-sized special ramen, please!! 
With a double gyoza, fried chicken, and 
fried rice set!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you don't have to match me on that! 
Let's just eat something good and fire 
ourselves up!

And so, the two of them ate delicious food 
to their hearts' content, recharging their 
energy for the battles to come—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Kakizome, huh...! I like the sound of 
that! They do say putting things into 
visible form is important, after all!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: If I'm gonna write it, it's gotta be—

And so, Katsuragi Ace and I wrote "BECOME 
AN ACE!!" in large letters on a sheet of 
paper, renewing our determination—
